outputs.content:
EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement is made between the Employer and the Employee named in Schedule 1.

1. POSITION AND DUTIES
The Employee is engaged as a Solar Care Technician and will perform the duties reasonably directed by the Employer, including rooftop work at customer premises.

2. AWARD AND REMUNERATION
This engagement is covered by the applicable modern award. The Employee will be paid at no less than the award rate for their classification, plus superannuation at the statutory rate.

3. HOURS AND LEAVE
Ordinary hours are 38 per week. Leave entitlements are those provided by the National Employment Standards.

4. WORK HEALTH AND SAFETY
The Employee will follow the Employer's height safety procedures and will not commence rooftop work without the required harness and anchor checks.

5. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate in accordance with the notice periods in the National Employment Standards.
